purpose: Teach: 参事官/占有/便宜/納付/受託/公然/始動/散会

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文部科学省の参事官と挨拶しろ
lines.en: Ren, go introduce yourself to the MEXT official.
lines.style: Clear, measured authority. Direct gaze. No inflection on the name — it's a simple direction, not a rebuke. Expectation is calm and unstated.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の占有スペースを記録しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm keeping track of our lab's allocated space.
lines.style: Careful, slightly rushed. Eager to show competence. Each phrase lands with precision — slightly too formal, trying to match the seriousness he sensed in the request.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、留学生に便宜を図れ
lines.en: Ren, make sure the international students are taken care of.
lines.style: Steady instruction, no pause. The tone says this is routine expectation, not special favor. Brief eye contact, already moving on mentally.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学費の納付期日を守ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure their tuition deadlines are met.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, slightly formal. A beat of hesitation — wondering if he understood the full scope of what was asked. Nods with quiet commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、産学連携の受託研究にも挑戦しろ
lines.en: Ren, push yourself on the industry partnership research too.
lines.style: Slight warmth underneath — this is a challenge, not a burden. Deliberate pace. A thin line of confidence in his capability, delivered without flattery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究公然のため学会で発表します
lines.en: Yes. I'll present our findings at the next conference to get the research visibility it needs.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Slight breathiness on 'findings' — he's already thinking through logistics. Ends firmly, as if he's made a silent commitment to himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、新実験装置を始動しろ
lines.en: Ren, get the new equipment up and running.
lines.style: Final instruction of the exchange. Clipped, efficient. A beat of expectation after the name — he has Ren's full attention and doesn't need to waste words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会終了後、参加者は散会しました
lines.en: Yes. The conference wrapped up and the attendees have already dispersed.
lines.style: Small, genuine smile underneath professional tone. He's reporting back — almost relieved, the task completed cleanly. Slightly quieter at the close, as if releasing tension.
